name: paper-collage-video
description: Create editable paper-collage and hand-drawn explainer videos with visual intake cards, three costed planning scenarios, enforced production-depth promises, registered asset families, and proof-backed rendering.

interface.shortDescription: 先选风格，再比较三档成本与动画深度的纸片视频
